nuggets.text: The Cowboys' first-ever game against the Giants, in 1960, ended 31-31: the first game the brand-new Cowboys did not lose.
The Cowboys' 40-40 tie with Green Bay in 2025 was their first tie game since 1969.
Brandon Aubrey is the only NFL player with multiple 64-plus-yard field goals, including one against the Giants last season.
Before kicking for the Cowboys, Brandon Aubrey was a first-round MLS draft pick by Toronto FC in 2017.
Brian Schottenheimer was Danny Wuerffel's backup quarterback on Florida's 1996 national championship team.
Von Miller has a degree in poultry science and raises chickens in his spare time.
Von Miller, a DeSoto native, joins the Cowboys tied with former Cowboy DeMarcus Ware for ninth-most sacks in NFL history.
Dak Prescott switched to No. 4 as a rookie to honor his mother's September 4 birthday.
Rookie Caleb Downs has NFL family: dad Gary was a running back, brother Josh is a Colts receiver, uncle Dre Bly played 11 years.
George Pickens watched himself get drafted in 2022 wearing a ski mask and basketball shorts in his family's living room.
